desc: Design the DP state: dp[i] = maximum score using first i elements, where dp[0] = 0
Implement the transition logic: for each position i, either skip it (dp[i] = dp[i-1]) or pair it with some j < i where the subarray (j+1, i-1) can be completely matched
Handle the pairing score calculation |A[i] - A[j]| and combine with inner matching scores
Implement input parsing to read N and the array A from stdin
Implement the O(N) DP with parity-class maxima tracking (best1[parity] = max of dp[j-1] - A[j], best2[parity] = max of dp[j-1] + A[j])
Verify correctness against samples mentally (sample 1: expect 5, sample 2: expect 14, sample 3: expect 0)
Output the final answer (max over all dp[i]) to stdout
